members.name: Anushree Pareek
members.bio: Anushree is someone who believes that meaningful impact begins with people. Thoughtful, dependable, and driven by empathy, she approaches every responsibility with sincerity and a genuine desire to make a difference. For her, the Placement Committee has never been just about placements; it has been about building a supportive community where every student feels guided, heard, and empowered. She hopes to leave behind a PlaceCom that students trust, value, and genuinely enjoy being a part of.

He is also keen to explore development consulting, especially with organisations such as Dalberg, The Bridgespan Group, and WJCF, where he can work closely on complex development challenges across countries and sectors. In the long run, he hopes to build a career that allows him to move between diplomacy, institutions, and implementation while contributing meaningfully to international development.

members.name: Harjas Chadha
members.bio: I’ve been a member of the Placement Committee since its inception, and I currently serve as the Systems & Automations Coordinator. Over the years, I’ve worked across student mentorship, quality assurance, and technology—leading the Placement Review & Audit Unit, reviewing 5,000+ resumes, and conducting 50+ office hours to support students. Today, I focus on building scalable systems, including the Placement Committee website and AI-powered automation tools, to make the placement experience more efficient, accessible, and student-friendly for the Ashoka community.
